description: vim `:w` with default writebackup: a `4913` writability probe is created and removed, the previous contents are renamed to a `notes.org~` backup, the new `notes.org` is written in place, and the `.notes.org.swp` swap file is flushed. One logical save; the target `notes.org` must coalesce to exactly one FileChanged. Offsets are milliseconds from the start of the save burst (all well within the 250ms debounce window). Modeled on documented vim save mechanics (`:h backup`, `:h swap-file`) — not a live capture.
